_doc: The model TIER of each workflow stage (backlog P10, spec S2-3). Every stage ships at top: a stage moves to mid or cheap ONLY with `proof`, the repo path of the JSON a PLANT RUN wrote (at least 3 planted defects of 3 different kinds, all caught by the cheaper agent, and one clean control with zero findings, for that stage, tier and template version); lint_templates.py checks it. `verify` is pinned to top in lint_templates.PINNED_TOP, so no edit here can move it. render.py --format json maps a tier to the workflow agent() model option via `agent_model` (top = no option: the coordinator's model).
